subject: SDK migration & endpoint cutover plan — Integrify
messages:
From: Paul Stevens <paul@integrify.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDK migration planning — Integrify phrasing

Hi Irene —

Thanks for taking this on. Quick summary of our ask: Integrify is moving from the legacy REST endpoints (v1) to your new SDK v2 in June. We want a clear, low-risk cutover plan that covers:
- SDK install and version pinning (we run Node + Python microservices)
- Endpoint migration (blue/green style if possible)
- Recommended retries/timeouts and backoff for transient errors
- Rate limit handling and quota bump procedure during launch
- A short list of fallback rules if the SDK behaves unexpectedly

Attached is our SOC/audit checklist that compliance will use during the rollout (audit_request.pdf). Can you send a concise, runnable plan and any sample snippets we can drop into our services?

Target: internal pilot by 2026-05-15, production cutover 2026-06-01.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30m call next week.

— Paul
Director of Engineering, Integrify

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Paul Stevens <paul@integrify.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDK migration & endpoint cutover plan — Integrify

Paul — thanks for the clear brief and the timeline. High-level plan below; I'll own coordination and will loop in CS/Impl for runbook delivery. I'll also attach a checklist (integration-checklist.xlsx) and a short sample repo link in a follow-up.

1) Pre-flight (week of 2026-04-19)
  - Confirm SDK versions: we recommend 2.1.0 for Node and 2.1.0 for Python (stable kernel selection).
  - Confirm call patterns & peak RPS per service (send telemetry export).
  - Account-level quota review — request temporary bump window 2026-05-29 to 2026-06-02 for cutover.

2) Sandbox integration (2026-04-26 -> 2026-05-10)
  - Install SDK, run integration smoke tests.
  - Implement transparent endpoint config: SDK supports "base_url" override for blue/green, so no code branching needed.
  - Add prefix/KV cache toggles; we'll provide recommended cache TTLs based on your seq lengths.

3) Pilot (2026-05-15 -> 2026-05-28)
  - Pilot on non-critical environment with 10–20% traffic routing to new SDK endpoint.
  - Validate latency, token consumption, and error profiles.

4) Cutover (2026-06-01)
  - Blue/green switch via config flip + rate-limited rollout stage by stage.
  - Escalation: automatic rollback if 5xx rate > 1.5x baseline or token cost > +20% and SLA breach.

Retries/Timeouts guidance (short):
  - Client-level timeouts: 10s for request timeout, 60s for streaming long responses.
  - Retries: idempotent GET-like calls: up to 3 retries with jittered exponential backoff (base 250ms, factor 2).
  - Backoff for 429/503: use Retry-After when provided, otherwise exponential up to 10s.
  - Safe defaults and sample code in the attached sample repo link.

Rate limit handling:
  - SDK exposes hooks for quota headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining). Implement soft-shutdown when remaining < 25% and surface a queue with token bucket ingress.

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

From: Paul Stevens <paul@integrify.com>

Cc: Integrify Support <support@integrify.com>
Date: 2026-04-16T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDK migration & endpoint cutover plan — Integrify

Irene / team —

This looks great. Quick clarifying question on retries: what is your recommended behavior for long-running streaming responses that intermittently time out? Our chat workers open a stream to generate replies and sometimes a 504 appears after 45s. If we retry naively we get duplicate message tokens.

Also, can you confirm the quota bump process and an anticipated lead time for approval?

Would like to take the 2026-04-15 4p slot you suggested but missed the confirmation — can we do 04-19 10a PT?

Thanks,
Paul

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Paul Stevens <paul@integrify.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-16T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDK migration & endpoint cutover plan — Integrify

Paul — quick answers here:

1) Streaming + duplicate tokens:
  - For streaming, prefer resumable streams (SDK v2 supports stream cursors) instead of full-request retries. If you must retry, use an at-least-once idempotency token at the application layer and deduplicate on server side.
  - Timeout guidance: set initial read timeout to 90s for streaming sockets; do not retry automatically on read timeouts unless you detect an incomplete token stream marker.

Example pseudo (server side dedupe):
  - client includes request_id in metadata
  - server stores last_processed_token_index for request_id
  - reconnection resumes from last_processed_token_index

2) Quota bump process:
  - Submit a quota request via your account contact (I submitted a tentative request for Integrify ID 12345 on 2026-04-11). Typical lead time: 48–72 hours for standard increases; enterprise SLA exceptions can be same-day if approved by sales/ops. I'll monitor and escalate if we need faster approval during cutover (call on 2026-04-19 10:00 PT confirmed).

I'll attach the final runbook after Monica/Vivek drop the last edits tomorrow morning.

See you Friday.

— Ire
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
